question: What alternative fee range applies when the donor is poor?
premises: An alternative is provided for a poor person.
The range begins with one niṣka.
The range extends up to five niṣkas.
inference: A poor donor may give a fee ranging from one niṣka up to five niṣkas.
plain_english: Or alternatively, a poor person may give from one niṣka up to five niṣkas.
